# technitium_settings_general (Resource)

Manages general DNS server settings: identity, listeners, record defaults, EDNS and network tuning.

This is a singleton: declare it once. Attributes left unset follow the server's current value. Destroying the resource only removes it from state; server settings are not reset.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `apps_enable_automatic_update` (Boolean) Update installed DNS apps automatically.
- `client_timeout` (Number) Milliseconds to wait for a resolution before answering ServerFailure.
- `default_ns_record_ttl` (Number) Default TTL for NS records.
- `default_record_ttl` (Number) Default TTL for new records.
- `default_responsible_person` (String) Default SOA responsible person email; empty for the server default.
- `default_soa_record_ttl` (Number) Default TTL for SOA records.
- `dns_server_domain` (String) Primary domain name the server uses to identify itself.
- `dnssec_validation` (Boolean) Validate DNSSEC for recursive and forwarded responses.
- `edns_client_subnet` (Boolean) Send EDNS Client Subnet (ECS) upstream.
- `edns_client_subnet_ipv4_override` (String) Fixed IPv4 network to send as ECS; empty to use the client's.
- `edns_client_subnet_ipv4_prefix_length` (Number) ECS IPv4 prefix length.
- `edns_client_subnet_ipv6_override` (String) Fixed IPv6 network to send as ECS; empty to use the client's.
- `edns_client_subnet_ipv6_prefix_length` (Number) ECS IPv6 prefix length.
- `enable_check_for_update` (Boolean) Check for server updates.
- `enable_edns_client_subnet_source_address` (Boolean) Treat the ECS address in requests as the client address (for DNS proxies).
- `enable_udp_socket_pool` (Boolean) Use a pool of random UDP ports for outbound queries.
- `ipv4_source_addresses` (List of String) IPv4 source addresses for outbound queries.
- `ipv6_mode` (String) IPv6 mode, e.g. `Disabled`, `Enabled` or `Preferred`.
- `ipv6_source_addresses` (List of String) IPv6 source addresses for outbound queries.
- `listen_backlog` (Number) Maximum pending inbound connections.
- `local_end_points` (List of String) Listen addresses with port, e.g. `0.0.0.0:53`, `[::]:53`.
- `max_concurrent_resolutions_per_core` (Number) Concurrent resolutions per CPU core.
- `min_soa_refresh` (Number) Minimum SOA refresh honoured for secondary zones.
- `min_soa_retry` (Number) Minimum SOA retry honoured for secondary zones.
- `notify_allowed_networks` (List of String) Networks allowed to NOTIFY all secondary zones.
- `quic_idle_timeout` (Number) QUIC idle timeout in milliseconds.
- `quic_max_inbound_streams` (Number) Maximum inbound QUIC streams per connection.
- `socket_pool_excluded_ports` (List of Number) Ports excluded from the UDP socket pool.
- `tcp_receive_timeout` (Number) TCP receive timeout in milliseconds.
- `tcp_send_timeout` (Number) TCP send timeout in milliseconds.
- `udp_payload_size` (Number) EDNS UDP payload size.
- `udp_receive_buffer_size_kb` (Number) UDP socket receive buffer size in KB.
- `udp_send_buffer_size_kb` (Number) UDP socket send buffer size in KB.
- `use_soa_serial_date_scheme` (Boolean) Default to the date-based SOA serial scheme for new zones.
- `zone_transfer_allowed_networks` (List of String) Networks allowed to transfer all zones without TSIG.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Always `settings`.
